details: Right-click an in-scope domain in Target to dynamically scan representative captured GET and HEAD request shapes. The plugin uses Lanius's bounded active scanner to check query, form, and top-level JSON inputs for database error behavior, raw HTML reflection, server-side template expression evaluation, and open redirects. It skips sensitive-looking inputs and non-idempotent methods by default, opens no sockets of its own, and sends no command-execution payloads.
